wippy.description: Configure the canonical Run Code Block in a Workflow editor. Pass the current Block configuration through the config prop; the component edits Lua, lets authors search and select actor-reachable tools, optionally names an exported method, and emits config-changed only after a user edit. An omitted or empty tool_ids selection means all tools the current actor can reach. The expandable SDK reference documents both the input and output schema for each callable tool.

config.description: Canonical Run Code Block configuration: code, optional tool_ids, and optional method. Omit tool_ids to allow all actor-reachable tools.
